# Time plots

Time plots of the evolution of noise and mean under Fluctuating selection

## Read params
read params from the establishment of mutation-selection balance & scenEvol

```{r read-params}
# read params (mutation-selection balance)
prmsS_forMutSelBalance <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "prmsS_forMutSelBalance"), 
                                     sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1)
NUM_NODES = prmsS_forMutSelBalance[rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "NUM_NODES", ]
NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance = prmsS_forMutSelBalance[rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "NUM_GENERATIONS", ]
prmsV_forMutSelBalance <- as.matrix(read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "prmsV_forMutSelBalance"),
                                               sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1))
ylim_noise_lower <- prmsS_forMutSelBalance[which(rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "MUTATION_DISTR_NOISE_LOWERBOUND"), ]
ylim_noise_upper <- prmsS_forMutSelBalance[which(rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "MUTATION_DISTR_NOISE_UPPERBOUND"), ]
ylim_sbasal_lower <- prmsS_forMutSelBalance[which(rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "MUTATION_DISTR_SBASAL_LOWERBOUND"), ]
ylim_sbasal_upper <- prmsS_forMutSelBalance[which(rownames(prmsS_forMutSelBalance) == "MUTATION_DISTR_SBASAL_UPPERBOUND"), ]

# calculate indices of genotypes, phenotypes, and fitness
numIDCols = 2
indIDCols = c(1, 2)
indGenotNoiseCols = seq(from = numIDCols  + 1, to = numIDCols  + NUM_NODES, by = 1)
indGenotSBasalCols = seq(from = numIDCols  + NUM_NODES + 1, to = numIDCols  + 2*NUM_NODES, by = 1)
indGenotNetCols = seq(from = numIDCols  + 2*NUM_NODES + 1, to = numIDCols  + 2*NUM_NODES + NUM_NODES^2, by = 1)
indPhenotypeCols = seq(from = numIDCols  + 2*NUM_NODES + NUM_NODES^2 + 1, to = numIDCols  + 3*NUM_NODES + NUM_NODES^2, by = 1)
indFitnessCol = numIDCols + length(indGenotNoiseCols) + length(indGenotSBasalCols) + 
                length(indGenotNetCols) + length(indPhenotypeCols) + 1
pop0FirstgenRealized <- read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "pop.MSB.firstgen"),
                                   sep = " ", header = FALSE)
sSteady = pop0FirstgenRealized[1, indPhenotypeCols]

# names
node_names = paste("G", 1:NUM_NODES, sep = "")
meanGenotColnames <- paste("meanG_", node_names, sep = "")
meanPhenotColnames <- paste("meanP_", node_names, sep = "")
varPhenotColnames <- paste("varP_", node_names, sep = "")

# read params (dirSel)
#prmsS_sel <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath, "prmsS_sel_oppDir_rep1"),
prmsS_sel <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "prmsS_fluctSel_rep1"),
                        sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1)
NUM_GENERATIONS = prmsS_sel[rownames(prmsS_sel) == "NUM_GENERATIONS", ]
S_MAX = prmsS_sel[rownames(prmsS_sel) == "S_MAX", ]
prmsV_39stab1dir <- as.matrix(read.table(paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "prmsV_39stab_1dirSelPos"),
                                         sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1))
#prmsV_39stab1dir <- as.matrix(read.table(paste0(resultsPath, "prmsV_39stab_1dirNeg"),
#                                         sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1))

# read params (fluctSel)
#prmsS_fluctSel <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath, "prmsS_fluctSel_rep1"),
#                        sep = " ", header = FALSE, row.names = 1)
#NUM_GENERATIONS = prmsS_sel[rownames(prmsS_sel) == "NUM_GENERATIONS", ]

# which genes had a change of selection regime?
indexSelGene <- as.integer(which(prmsV_39stab1dir["S_OPT_DELTA", ] != 0))
```

## Fluct sel

```{r read-dir-sel}
# get sOpt value for the gene under dir.
sOpt1 <- prmsV_39stab1dir[rownames(prmsV_39stab1dir) == "S_OPT", indexSelGene] +
  prmsV_39stab1dir[rownames(prmsV_39stab1dir) == "S_OPT_DELTA", indexSelGene]
sOpt2 <- prmsV_39stab1dir[rownames(prmsV_39stab1dir) == "S_OPT", indexSelGene] -
  prmsV_39stab1dir[rownames(prmsV_39stab1dir) == "S_OPT_DELTA", indexSelGene]

dirHist <- MSBHist
dirHist$rep <- 0
dirNoises <- MSBNoises
dirNoises$rep <- 0
dirSbasals <- MSBSbasals
dirSbasals$rep <-0 

for(repNum in 1:numReps)
{
  # read hist file
  #hist <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath, "dirSelOpp_rep", repNum, ".hist"), header = FALSE)
  hist <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath, "fluctSel_rep", repNum, ".hist"), header = FALSE)
  colnames(hist) <- c("generation", meanPhenotColnames, varPhenotColnames, "meanF")
  hist$rep <- repNum
  hist$generation <- hist$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance
  
  # read noises file
  #noises <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath,"dirSelOpp_rep", repNum, ".noises"), header = FALSE)
  noises <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath,"fluctSel_rep", repNum, ".noises"), header = FALSE)
  colnames(noises) <- c("generation", meanGenotColnames)
  noises$rep <- repNum
  noises$generation <- noises$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance
  
  # read sbasals file
  #sbasals <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsPath,"dirSelOpp_rep", repNum, ".sbasals"), header = FALSE)
  sbasals <- read.table(file = paste0(resultsFolderForTimePlotsPath,"fluctSel_rep", repNum, ".sbasals"), header = FALSE)
  colnames(sbasals) <- c("generation", meanGenotColnames)
  sbasals$rep <- repNum
  sbasals$generation <- sbasals$generation + NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance
  
  dirHist <- rbind(dirHist, hist)
  dirNoises <- rbind(dirNoises, noises)
  dirSbasals <- rbind(dirSbasals, sbasals)
}
```

```{r plot-dir-sel}
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  #geom_smooth(color = "black", linetype = "dotted") +
  ylab("Intrinsic noise")
  #ylim(-1, 15)
#plot_selGene_noise_dirSel
#ggsave(filename = "plot_selGene_noise_fluctSel.png",
#       plot = plot_selGene_noise_dirSel,
#       path = plotsFolderWithPath_fluctSel,
#       device = "png", scale = 2.5, width = 6, height = 5, units = "cm",
#       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE,
#       bg = "white")

plot_selGene_sbasal_dirSel <- ggplot(data = dirSbasals[ , c(1, indexSelGene + 1, dim(dirSbasals)[2])], 
                       aes(x = generation, y = get(paste0("meanG_", node_names[indexSelGene])))) +
  geom_point(aes(group = rep), size = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, color = genotypeSBasalColor) +
  geom_line(aes(group = rep), size = 0.25, alpha = 0.5, color = genotypeSBasalColor) +
  stat_summary(data = dirSbasals[dirSbasals$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance,
                                 c(1, indexSelGene + 1, dim(dirSbasals)[2])], 
                                     aes(x = generation, y = get(paste0("meanG_", node_names[indexSelGene]))),
               fun = mean, geom = 'line', size = 1.5, color = genotypeSBasalColor) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sOpt1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = sOpt2, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate('text', x = 1500, y = sOpt1 - 3, label = 'Optimum 1') + 
  annotate('text', x = 1500, y = sOpt2 + 3, label = 'Optimum 2') + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance, color = "black", alpha = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  #geom_vline(xintercept = generationAdaptationOccurs, color = "black", alpha = 1, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_smooth(data = dirSbasals[dirSbasals$generation < NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance,
                              c(1, indexSelGene + 1, dim(dirSbasals)[2])],
              color = "black", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_smooth(data = dirSbasals[dirSbasals$generation > NUM_GENERATIONS_mutSelBalance,
                              c(1, indexSelGene + 1, dim(dirSbasals)[2])],
              color = "black", linetype = "dotted") +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  ylab("Basal expression level") +
  ylim(-1, 100)
```

# Net evol: Fluctuating selection
Read the genotype, phenotype and fitness information of evolved populations of 2000 random network topology samples.

```{r read-data-dir-sel}
#allNetsResults <- read.table(paste0(resultsPathAll, "allNetsResults_dirSelPos.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
allNetsResults <- read.table(paste0(resultsPathAll, "allNetsResults_prepped_fluctSel.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
#allNetsResults$adapted <- (allNetsResults$timeToAdapt != "Not_applied") &
#                          (allNetsResults$timeToAdapt != "NC_adaptation") &
#                          (allNetsResults$timeToAdapt != "Nonadaptive")
allNetsResults$underFluctSel <- allNetsResults$sOptDelta != 0
allNetsResults$regCategory <- factor(allNetsResults$regCategory, levels = c("masterTF", "interTF", "TG"))

# there are 3 isolated (nonconnected) genes in network 4, it's a mistake from RGenNet. The network has 6 componenets (subnetworks).
# I remove it because this network has subnetworks.
allNetsResults <- allNetsResults[-which(allNetsResults$net == 4), ]

#
# subset networks in which the gene adapted
#numbersOfNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsResults$net[allNetsResults$adapted == TRUE]
#allNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsResults[allNetsResults$net %in% numbersOfNetsWithAdaptedGenes, ]
#allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$timeToAdapt_dirSel <- as.numeric(as.character(allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$timeToAdapt_dirSel))

#
#netsWithInf <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$net[is.infinite(allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$aveNormChangeVar_PA)]
#allNetsWithAdaptedGenes <- allNetsWithAdaptedGenes[!allNetsWithAdaptedGenes$net %in% netsWithInf, ]


allNetsResults <- allNetsResults[allNetsResults$aveNormChangeVar_A < 1000, ]

allNetsResults <- allNetsResults[-60158, ]

# all genes under dir and stab sel
genesUnderFluctSel <- allNetsResults[allNetsResults$underFluctSel == "TRUE", ]
genesUnderStabSel <- allNetsResults[allNetsResults$underFluctSel == "FALSE", ]

genesUnderFluctSel$adapted <- genesUnderFluctSel$selpress_eta_A > 1
genesUnderStabSel$adapted <- genesUnderStabSel$selpress_eta_A > 1
```

## Adaptation (yes/no)

### Adapted - regCategory - fluctSel

```{r preview-adapted-genes-per-regcategory}
contingencyTable <- table(genesUnderFluctSel[, c("regCategory", "adapted")])
mosaicplot(contingencyTable, main = "Mosaic plot", color = TRUE)

chisq.test(contingencyTable)
#fisher.test(contingencyTable)
prop.test(contingencyTable)

percF <- contingencyTable[,1]/rowSums(contingencyTable)
percT <- contingencyTable[,2]/rowSums(contingencyTable)
perc <- cbind(rep(names(percF), 2), c(rep("FALSE", 3), rep("TRUE", 3)), c(percF, percT))
colnames(perc) <- c("regCategory", "adapted", "percent")

contingencyTable_melted <- melt(contingencyTable)
contingencyTable_melted <- merge(contingencyTable_melted, perc, by = c("regCategory", "adapted"))
contingencyTable_melted$percent <- as.numeric(as.character(contingencyTable_melted$percent))

# percentage labels
contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition <- contingencyTable_melted$value 
contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition[contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "TRUE"] <-
  contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition[contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "TRUE"]/2
contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition[contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "FALSE"] <-
  ((contingencyTable_melted$value[contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "FALSE"]/2) + 
  contingencyTable_melted$value[contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "TRUE"])
contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition[contingencyTable_melted$regCategory == "TG" & contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "FALSE"] <- 
  contingencyTable_melted$percentPosition[contingencyTable_melted$regCategory == "TG" & contingencyTable_melted$adapted == "FALSE"] + 75

plot_bars_fluctSel <- ggplot(contingencyTable_melted, aes(x = regCategory, y = value, fill = adapted)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", colour = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = regCategory, y = percentPosition, label = paste0(round(percent*100, digits = 2),"%")), size = 2) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1", name = "Adapted", labels = c("FALSE" = "No", "TRUE" = "Yes")) +
  labs(x = "Regulatory gene category", y = "Number of genes")
plot_bars_fluctSel
ggsave(filename = sprintf("plot_bars_fluctSelPos.png"),
       path = plotsFolderWithPath_fluctSel,
       plot = plot_bars_fluctSel, 
       device = "png", scale = 2, width = 6, height = 8, units = "cm",
       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE)
```

```{r wilcox-tests-phenotnoise}
wilcox.test(genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A, genesUnderStabSel$aveNormChangeVar_A, alternative = "greater")
wilcox.test(genesUnderFluctSel$selpress_eta_A, genesUnderStabSel$selpress_eta_A, alternative = "greater")
wilcox.test(genesUnderFluctSel$selpress_sbasal_A, genesUnderStabSel$selpress_sbasal_A, alternative = "greater")


# comparisons between the reg categories
wilcox.test(genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "TG"], 
            genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "interTF"],
            alternative = "greater")
wilcox.test(genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "TG"], 
            genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "masterTF"],
            alternative = "greater")

wilcox.test(genesUnderFluctSel$selpress_eta_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "TG"], 
            genesUnderFluctSel$selpress_eta_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "interTF"],
            alternative = "greater")

            genesUnderFluctSel$selpress_eta_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "masterTF"],
            alternative = "greater")
```

### Stats - aveNormVar

```{r wilcox-tests-phenotnoise}
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise <- data.frame(regCategory = factor(c("masterTF", "masterTF",  
                                      "interTF", "interTF", 
                                      "TG", "TG"), 
                                    levels = c("masterTF", "interTF", "TG")),
                       Selection = factor(c("Fluctuating", "Stabilizing", "Fluctuating", "Stabilizing",
                                           "Fluctuating", "Stabilizing"),
                                    levels = c("Fluctuating", "Stabilizing")),
                       numGenes = NA, aveNormChangeVar = NA, pval = NA, pval.corrected = NA, lab = NA)

### change of variance after selection is applied

## masterTF
# masterTF, Fluctuating
rowIndex <- wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$regCategory == "masterTF" & wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$Selection == "Fluctuating"
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "numGenes"] <-
  length(genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "masterTF"])
wilcoxTest <- wilcox.test(genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "masterTF"], 
                          mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided")
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "aveNormChangeVar"] <-
  median(genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "masterTF"])
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "pval"] <- wilcoxTest$p.value
# masterTF,  Stabilizing
rowIndex <- wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$regCategory == "masterTF" & wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$Selection == "Stabilizing"
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "numGenes"] <-
  length(genesUnderStabSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderStabSel$regCategory == "masterTF"])
wilcoxTest <- wilcox.test(genesUnderStabSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderStabSel$regCategory == "masterTF"],
                          mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided")
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "aveNormChangeVar"] <-
  median(genesUnderStabSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderStabSel$regCategory == "masterTF"])
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "pval"] <- wilcoxTest$p.value

## interTF
# interTF, Fluctuating
rowIndex <- wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$regCategory == "interTF" & wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$Selection == "Fluctuating"
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "numGenes"] <-
  length(genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "interTF"])
wilcoxTest <- wilcox.test(genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "interTF"],
                          mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided")
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "aveNormChangeVar"] <-
  median(genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "interTF"])
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "pval"] <- wilcoxTest$p.value
# interTF, Stabilizing
rowIndex <- wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$regCategory == "interTF" & wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$Selection == "Stabilizing"
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "numGenes"] <-
  length(genesUnderStabSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderStabSel$regCategory == "interTF"])
wilcoxTest <- wilcox.test(genesUnderStabSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderStabSel$regCategory == "interTF"],
                          mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided")
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "aveNormChangeVar"] <-
  median(genesUnderStabSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderStabSel$regCategory == "interTF"])

## TG
# TG, Fluctuating

                          mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided")
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "aveNormChangeVar"] <-
  median(genesUnderFluctSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderFluctSel$regCategory == "TG"])
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise[rowIndex, "pval"] <- wilcoxTest$p.value
# TG, Stabilizing
rowIndex <- wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$regCategory == "TG" & wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$Selection == "Stabilizing"

  length(genesUnderStabSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderStabSel$regCategory == "TG"])

                          mu = 0, alternative = "two.sided")

  median(genesUnderStabSel$aveNormChangeVar_A[genesUnderStabSel$regCategory == "TG"])

# Bonferroni correction
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$pval.corrected <- wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$pval*dim(wilcoxTests_phenotNoise)[1]
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$signif <- wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$pval.corrected < 0.05
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$lab <- "ns"
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$lab[wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$pval.corrected <= 0.05] <- "*"
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$lab[wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$pval.corrected < 0.01] <- "**"
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$lab[wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$pval.corrected < 0.001] <- "***"
wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$lab[wilcoxTests_phenotNoise$pval.corrected < 0.0001] <- "****"
```

```{r comparisons-of-three-variables}

#### expression variance
varChangesDiffPhases <- allNetsResults[, c("aveNormChangeVar_A", "regCategory", "underFluctSel")]
varChangesDiffPhases$underFluctSel[varChangesDiffPhases$underFluctSel == "TRUE"] <- 'Fluctuating'
varChangesDiffPhases$underFluctSel[varChangesDiffPhases$underFluctSel == "FALSE"] <- 'Stabilizing'
colnames(varChangesDiffPhases)[which(colnames(varChangesDiffPhases) == "underFluctSel")] <- "Selection"
varChangesDiffPhases$Selection <- factor(varChangesDiffPhases$Selection, levels = c("Fluctuating", "Stabilizing"))

stat.test <- varChangesDiffPhases %>%
  group_by(regCategory) %>%
  wilcox_test(aveNormChangeVar_A ~ Selection) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
  add_significance()
stat.test <- stat.test %>% add_x_position(x = "regCategory", dodge = 0.6)

plot_varChangesDiffPhases <- ggplot(varChangesDiffPhases, 
                                    aes(x = regCategory, y = aveNormChangeVar_A)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Selection, col = Selection),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.6), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.2) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Selection, col = Selection),
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.25, colour = "black") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.adj.signif", y.position = 18, step.increase = 0, tip.length = 0.001) +
  geom_label(data = wilcoxTests_phenotNoise, aes(x = regCategory, y = -3, 
                                             label = as.character(round(aveNormChangeVar, digits = 2)),
                                             colour = Selection), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 4, fontface = "bold", 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Fluctuating" = noiseColor, "Stabilizing" = "darkgray")) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Fluctuating" = noiseColor, "Stabilizing" = "darkgray")) +  
  ylim(-5, 20) +
  labs(x = "Regulatory gene category", y = expression(bold("Mean"~Delta~"expression variance")))
plot_varChangesDiffPhases
```

## MSB optimum and eq variance

```{r MSBAve-means-and-vars, eval = FALSE}
#setwd("..")
setwd(paste0("../results/", resultsFolder_DirSelPos))
MSBAve <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = 0))
for(netNum in 1:500)
{
  setwd(paste0("net_", netNum, sep = ""))
  MSB <- read.table("MSBAve.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
  MSBAve <- rbind(MSBAve, MSB)
  setwd("..")
}

plot_sOpt_MSBMean <- ggplot(MSBAve, aes(x = S_OPT, y = MSBAveMeanPheno)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, color = noiseColor, size = 0.2) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold")) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  labs(x = expression("S_OPT"), y = "Equilibrium mean expression level")
plot_sOpt_MSBMean
plot_sOpt_MSBVar <- ggplot(MSBAve, aes(x = S_OPT, y = MSBAveVarP)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, color = noiseColor, size = 0.2) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold")) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  labs(x = expression("S_OPT"), y = "Equilibrium var expression level") +
  ylim(0, 500)
plot_sOpt_MSBVar
cor.test(MSBAve$S_OPT, MSBAve$MSBAveVarP, method = "spearman", exact = F)
cor.test(MSBAve$S_OPT, MSBAve$MSBAveVarP, method = "pearson")
cor.test(MSBAve$S_OPT, MSBAve$MSBAveVarP, method = "kendall")
plot_sOpt_MSBMean <- ggplot(MSBAve, aes(x = S_OPT, y = MSBAveMeanGEta)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, color = noiseColor, size = 0.2) +
  theme_pubclean() + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=8, face="bold")) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  labs(x = expression("S_OPT"), y = "MSBAveMeanGEta")
plot_sOpt_MSBMean

ggplot2::ggsave(filename = sprintf("plot_sOpt_MSBMean.png"),
       path = plotsFolderWithPath_dirSelPos,
       plot = plot_sOpt_MSBMean, bg = "white",
       device = "png", scale = 2, width = 6, height = 6, units = "cm",
       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE)
ggplot2::ggsave(filename = sprintf("plot_sOpt_MSBVar.png"),
       path = plotsFolderWithPath_dirSelPos,
       plot = plot_sOpt_MSBVar, bg = "white",
       device = "png", scale = 2, width = 6, height = 6, units = "cm",
       dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE)
```
